purpose: Independent full-wall workbench for wall core, adobe masonry, exterior and interior plaster, stone plinth, door closure, continuous erosion, cavities and straw fibres.

primaryRules: adobe courses continue from the stone plinth to the wall top with only a thin adjustable closure gap
adobe units are embedded into the core and protrude only slightly on exterior and interior faces
exterior and interior plaster are independent thin layers with continuous remnants and irregular loss boundaries
stone plinth and first adobe course overlap slightly to avoid a floating seam
rounded edge erosion, pitting, small cavities, straw exposure and large weathering share continuous noise fields
door opening, frame, lintel, piers and upper wall are derived from one closure contract

geometryContract.doorOpening: derived from frame width, lintel height and closure overlap
geometryContract.topClosure: adobe course pitch is redistributed to reach wallHeight minus topClosureGap
geometryContract.interiorExterior: two independently controllable plaster and brick faces share one tapered core

noiseStack.Perlin: low-frequency wall undulation and material macro variation
noiseStack.Simplex: domain warping, rain flow and continuous erosion direction
noiseStack.Worley: rounded missing corners, pits, cavities and patch-edge bites
